title: LongSearchEval: Evaluating Long-Horizon Web Search Capabilities of Large Language Models via a Trajectory-Aware Agent Framework with Failure-Node Localization
title_zh: LongSearchEval：通过具备失败节点定位的轨迹感知智能体框架评估大语言模型的长程网络搜索能力

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon web search requires LLM-based agents to integrate information across webpages through extended interactions under task-specific constraints. Evaluating this capability is important not only for measuring final answer quality, but also for assessing whether an agent acquires, verifies, and uses evidence reliably over extended interactions. Existing evaluations, however, mainly rely on simulated trajectories or on post-hoc trajectories reconstructed from final answers, rather than on retained real interaction traces, which limits the fidelity of behavioral assessment and weakens support for fine-grained error localization. To address this gap, we introduce LongSearchEval , a trajectory-aware agent evaluation framework that combines a unified agent execution protocol with source-constrained outcome verification and retrospective failure-node localization. Stage 1 verifies answer groups against agent-cited webpages without human-authored gold answers; Stage 2 audits normalized rounds and links flagged failure nodes to incorrect answer groups. We evaluate 16 models from eight families on 100 tasks, yielding 1,600 retained runs and 6,545 automatically flagged failure nodes. Trajectory collection and evaluation required 1,037 and 318 hours of cumulative runtime, respectively. Human validation yields 94.50% agreement on supplied answer-group labels and 98.11% feature-correspondence precision for audited round–group links. Together, outcome scores and linked trajectory evidence support controlled model comparison and retrospective inspection of answer-related content.
paragraphs.zh: 长程网络搜索要求基于大语言模型的智能体在任务特定约束下，通过多轮扩展交互整合跨网页的信息。 评估这一能力不仅对衡量最终答案质量很重要，也对评估智能体在长程交互中是否可靠地获取、验证和使用证据很重要。 然而，现有评估主要依赖模拟轨迹或从最终答案事后重建的轨迹，而非保留的真实交互痕迹，这限制了行为评估的保真度，也削弱了对细粒度错误定位的支持。 为弥补这一空白，我们提出 LongSearchEval，这是一个轨迹感知的智能体评估框架，它将统一的智能体执行协议与基于来源约束的结果验证以及回溯式失败节点定位相结合。 阶段 1 在没有人工撰写标准答案的情况下，对照智能体所引用的网页验证答案组；阶段 2 审计规范化后的轮次，并将被标记的失败节点链接到不正确的答案组。 我们在 100 个任务上评估了来自八个系列的 16 个模型，得到 1,600 次保留运行和 6,545 个自动标记的失败节点。 轨迹收集与评估分别需要 1,037 小时和 318 小时的累计运行时间。 人工验证显示，在提供的答案组标签上达到 94.50% 的一致性，在受审计的轮次—答案组链接上达到 98.11% 的特征对应精确率。 结果分数与关联的轨迹证据共同支持受控的模型比较以及对答案相关内容的回溯式检查。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in language understanding, generation, and complex reasoning, enabling a broad range of applications beyond traditional natural language processing Brown et al. (2020) . Building on these capabilities, LLM-based agents extend models from passive generation to autonomous problem solving by interacting with external environments Yao et al. (2023) ; Wang et al. (2024c) . Web search enables language models to acquire external and up-to-date information by retrieving and inspecting web sources beyond their parametric knowledge Nakano et al. (2021) . Agentic web search further transforms retrieval into autonomous information seeking, where agents decompose complex queries, navigate webpages, verify evidence, and synthesize citation-supported responses Gou et al. (2025) .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在语言理解、生成和复杂推理方面展现出卓越的能力，使其能够支持超越传统自然语言处理的广泛应用 Brown et al. (2020)。 基于这些能力，基于LLM的智能体通过与外部环境交互，将模型从被动生成扩展到自主问题求解 Yao et al. (2023)；Wang et al. (2024c)。 网络搜索使语言模型能够通过检索和查看超出其参数化知识的网络资源来获取外部和最新信息 Nakano et al. (2021)。 智能体式网络搜索进一步将检索转变为自主的信息寻求，其中智能体分解复杂查询、浏览网页、验证证据并综合生成有引用支持的回答 Gou et al. (2025)。

paragraphs.en: Early approaches have explored complementary directions toward autonomous web information seeking. Mind2Web Deng et al. (2023) , WebArena Zhou et al. (2024) , and AgentBench Liu et al. (2024a) establish general benchmarks for real-world websites, reproducible browser environments, and multi-domain agent evaluation. WebVoyager He et al. (2024) , WebLINX Lu et al. (2024) , and VisualWebArena Koh et al. (2024) extend evaluation to multimodal or dialogue-conditioned web interaction. AssistantBench Yoran et al. (2024) , WorkArena Drouin et al. (2024) , WorkArena++ Boisvert et al. (2024) , and TravelPlanner Xie et al. (2024a) examine realistic, time-consuming, or compositional tasks that require extended information gathering and planning. AppWorld Trivedi et al. (2024) , OSWorld Xie et al. (2024b) , AndroidWorld Rawles et al. (2025) , and τ \tau -bench Yao et al. (2025) further introduce stateful applications, open-ended computer environments, and tool–user interaction protocols. Collectively, these benchmarks substantially improve the realism and scope of agent evaluation, while leaving limited support for jointly verifying source-grounded final answers and locating related evidence in comparable open-web trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的研究已经探索了面向自主化网络信息获取的互补方向。Mind2Web（Deng et al. (2023)）、WebArena（Zhou et al. (2024)）和 AgentBench（Liu et al. (2024a)）分别为真实网站、可复现的浏览器环境以及多领域智能体评估建立了通用基准。WebVoyager（He et al. (2024)）、WebLINX（Lu et al. (2024)）和 VisualWebArena（Koh et al. (2024)）将评估扩展到多模态或以对话为条件的网络交互。 AssistantBench（Yoran et al. (2024)）、WorkArena（Drouin et al. (2024)）、WorkArena++（Boisvert et al. (2024)）和 TravelPlanner（Xie et al. (2024a)）考察了需要长时间信息收集与规划的现实性、耗时性或组合性任务。AppWorld（Trivedi et al. (2024)）、OSWorld（Xie et al. (2024b)）、AndroidWorld（Rawles et al. (2025)）和 τ \tau -bench（Yao et al. (2025)）进一步引入了有状态的应用、开放式的计算机环境以及工具与用户交互协议。 总体而言，这些基准显著提升了智能体评估的真实性和覆盖范围，但在联合验证基于来源的最终答案以及定位可比开放网络轨迹中的相关证据方面，其支持仍然有限。

paragraphs.en: Recent research has increasingly focused on evaluating DeepSearch agents from two complementary perspectives. The first direction emphasizes source-grounded final-answer evaluation ( Figure 1(a) ). Mind2Web 2 Gou et al. (2025) introduces realistic long-horizon agentic-search tasks and rubric-based Agent-as-a-Judge evaluation. GAIA Mialon et al. (2024) , AssistantBench Yoran et al. (2024) , LiveResearchBench Wang et al. (2025) , and BrowseComp Wei et al. (2025) evaluate complex information seeking under external-knowledge, live-web, or persistent-browsing requirements. RAGChecker Ru et al. (2024) , long-form factuality Wei et al. (2024) evaluation, and RAGTruth Niu et al. (2024) provide finer-grained analyses of retrieval support, claim correctness, and hallucination in grounded generation. Because these settings often rely on LLM-based evaluators, a parallel line of work studies judge construction Zheng et al. (2023) and meta-evaluation Zeng et al. (2024) through pairwise comparison, adversarial instruction-following cases, critique generation Ke et al. (2024) , rubric-conditioned scoring Kim et al. (2024) , hierarchical criteria Liu et al. (2024b) , and judge-specific benchmarks Tan et al. (2025) . Other studies identify systematic evaluator biases, including unfair comparison behavior Wang et al. (2024a) and self-preference Panickssery et al. (2024) . These methods substantially improve outcome evaluation, but their primary object remains the generated answer and its supporting evidence rather than the observable search process that produced it. The second direction investigates process-level evaluation and error localization ( Figure 1(b) ). Let’s Verify Step by Step Lightman et al. (2024) , Math-Shepherd Wang et al. (2024b) , and ProcessBench Zheng et al. (2025) show that intermediate-step verification Lightman et al. (2024) can reveal reasoning failures beyond final-answer accuracy. AgentBoard Ma et al. (2024) introduces progress-level diagnostics for multi-turn agents, while analyses of error snowballing Zhang et al. (2024) show how early mistakes can induce downstream failures. TELBench and DRIFT Wang et al. (2026) further adapt process localization to DeepResearch trajectories by segmenting agent trajectories and identifying harmful error spans. These approaches demonstrate the value of process-level diagnosis. Human-verified labels support their evaluation benchmarks, which is distinct from requiring such labels as localization inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究越来越注重从两个互补的视角评估 DeepSearch 智能体。 第一个方向强调基于来源的最终答案评估（ 图 1(a) ）。Mind2Web 2（Gou 等， 2025）引入了现实的长程智能体搜索任务以及基于评分标准的 Agent-as-a-Judge 评估。GAIA（Mialon 等， 2024）、AssistantBench（Yoran 等， 2024）、LiveResearchBench（Wang 等， 2025）以及 BrowseComp（Wei 等， 2025）在外部知识、实时网络或持续浏览的要求下评估复杂的信息检索。RAGChecker（Ru 等， 2024）、长文本事实性（Wei 等， 2024）评估以及 RAGTruth（Niu 等， 2024）为有据生成中的检索支持、论断正确性和幻觉提供了更细粒度的分析。 由于这些场景往往依赖基于 LLM 的评估器，另一条平行的研究线路研究评判器的构建（Zheng 等， 2023）与元评估（Zeng 等， 2024），包括成对比较、对抗性指令遵循案例、评论生成（Ke 等， 2024）、基于评分标准的打分（Kim 等， 2024）、分层准则（Liu 等， 2024b）以及专门的评判器基准（Tan 等， 2025）。 另一些研究指出评估器存在系统性偏差，包括不公平的比较行为（Wang 等， 2024a）和自我偏好（Panickssery 等， 2024）。 这些方法显著改进了结果评估，但它们的主要对象仍是生成的答案及其支撑证据，而非产生该答案的可观察搜索过程。 第二个方向研究过程级评估与错误定位（ 图 1(b) ）。 Let’s Verify Step by Step（Lightman 等， 2024）、Math-Shepherd（Wang 等， 2024b）以及 ProcessBench（Zheng 等， 2025）表明，中间步骤验证（Lightman 等， 2024）能够揭示最终答案准确率之外的推理失败。AgentBoard（Ma 等， 2024）为多轮智能体引入了进度级诊断，而对错误滚雪球效应的分析（Zhang 等， 2024）则展示了早期错误如何引发下游失败。 TELBench 和 DRIFT（Wang 等， 2026）通过切分智能体轨迹并识别有害的错误片段，进一步将过程定位适配到 DeepResearch 轨迹上。 这些方法展示了过程级诊断的价值。 它们的评估基准依赖人工验证的标签，这与要求将此类标签作为定位输入是不同的。

paragraphs.en: Our focus is the outcome-conditioned connection between answer groups judged incorrect and retained web-search content under a unified agent execution protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的关注点在于，在统一的智能体执行协议下，被判为错误的答案组与保留的网页搜索内容之间以结果为条件的联系。

paragraphs.en: In response to these challenges, we introduce LongSearchEval , a trajectory-aware agent evaluation framework for assessing the long-horizon web-search capabilities of LLMs ( Figure 1(c) ). Each evaluated LLM operates within a shared agent controller and standardized web-tool interface, and its final response is assessed together with the observable trajectory that produced it. The shared controller and restricted tool outputs standardize the interaction conditions, connecting model-level comparison with inspectable evidence of search behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 针对这些挑战，我们提出了 LongSearchEval，这是一个面向轨迹的智能体评估框架，用于评估大语言模型的长程网络搜索能力（图 1(c)）。 每个被评估的大语言模型都在共享的智能体控制器和标准化的网络工具接口下运行，其最终回答与产生该回答的可观测轨迹一起被评估。 共享的控制器和受限的工具输出使交互条件标准化，从而将模型层面的比较与可查验的搜索行为证据联系起来。

sents.en: In response to these challenges, we introduce LongSearchEval , a trajectory-aware agent evaluation framework for assessing the long-horizon web-search capabilities of LLMs ( Figure 1(c) ).
sents.zh: 针对这些挑战，我们提出了 LongSearchEval，这是一个面向轨迹的智能体评估框架，用于评估大语言模型的长程网络搜索能力（图 1(c)）。

sents.en: The shared controller and restricted tool outputs standardize the interaction conditions, connecting model-level comparison with inspectable evidence of search behavior.
sents.zh: 共享的控制器和受限的工具输出使交互条件标准化，从而将模型层面的比较与可查验的搜索行为证据联系起来。

paragraphs.en: LongSearchEval combines controlled trajectory collection with two evaluation stages. Source-constrained outcome verification checks final-answer groups using only the webpages cited by the agent, without requiring human-authored gold answers. Conditioned on the final response and Stage 1 judgments, retrospective failure-node localization links related content, sources, or fields to groups judged incorrect. The returned associations expose where constraint-relevant evidence for each incorrect group appears in the trajectory. A correct webpage observation can still expose an answer discrepancy. These associations support retrospective inspection, not identification of an agent’s first erroneous commitment.
paragraphs.zh: LongSearchEval 将受控的轨迹收集与两个评估阶段相结合。 来源约束的结果验证仅使用智能体引用的网页来检查最终答案组，而无需人工撰写的标准答案。 以最终响应和第一阶段判定为条件，回溯性失败节点定位将与相关内容、来源或字段的关联链接到被判定为不正确的组。 返回的关联揭示了每个不正确组相关的约束性证据在轨迹中的出现位置。 一个正确的网页观察仍可能暴露答案差异。 这些关联支持回溯性检查，而非识别智能体的首次错误承诺。

paragraphs.en: We apply LongSearchEval to 16 models from eight families on 100 real-world web-search tasks, yielding 1,600 retained runs. Trajectory collection and evaluation required 1,037 and 318 hours, respectively. Human review of 946 supplied answer groups from 200 responses yields 94.50% agreement with automatic judgments, while Answer Score and Answer Precision correlate with human scores at Pearson coefficients of 0.9054 and 0.9132. In a separate run sample, review of all 317 retained round–group links confirms 311 feature correspondences (98.11%). The experiments also reveal distinct search and reading patterns among models with similar answer scores.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 LongSearchEval 应用于来自八个系列的 16 个模型，完成 100 个真实世界的网页搜索任务，共保留 1,600 次运行记录。 轨迹收集与评估分别耗时 1,037 小时和 318 小时。 对来自 200 个回答的 946 个提供答案组进行人工审核，结果与自动判定的一致率为 94.50%，而答案分数（Answer Score）与答案精确率（Answer Precision）与人工分数的皮尔逊相关系数分别为 0.9054 和 0.9132。 在另一份运行样本中，对全部 317 条保留的轮次—组链接的审核确认了 311 个特征对应关系（98.11%）。 实验还揭示了答案分数相近的模型之间截然不同的搜索与阅读模式。

paragraphs.en: We formulate long-horizon web-search evaluation as a joint analysis of source-supported outcomes and observable trajectories under a controlled agent protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将长周期网页搜索评估形式化为在受控智能体协议下，对有来源支持的结果与可观测轨迹的联合分析。

paragraphs.en: We introduce LongSearchEval , which combines trajectory collection under a unified execution protocol, source-constrained verification, and retrospective localization of content related to Stage 1 incorrect groups, without gold answers or pre-labeled process errors as operational inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 LongSearchEval，它将在统一执行协议下的轨迹收集、基于来源约束的验证，以及针对第一阶段错误组的回顾性内容定位结合在一起，且无需将标准答案或预先标注的过程错误作为操作性输入。

paragraphs.en: We build a 1,600-run corpus covering 16 LLMs and 100 tasks, with human validation of 946 supplied answer groups and all 317 retained links in fixed samples.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个包含 1,600 次运行的语料库，涵盖 16 个大语言模型和 100 个任务，并对固定样本中提供的 946 组答案以及所有 317 条保留链接进行了人工验证。

paragraphs.en: Web Agent Evaluation. Web-agent evaluation has progressed from isolated browsing actions toward realistic long-horizon interaction and evidence-grounded task completion. Mind2Web Deng et al. (2023) introduces large-scale real-world website tasks for generalist web agents, while WebArena Zhou et al. (2024) provides realistic multi-website environments for autonomous interaction. AgentBench Liu et al. (2024a) evaluates LLMs as agents across diverse environments. WebVoyager He et al. (2024) , WebLINX Lu et al. (2024) , and VisualWebArena Koh et al. (2024) extend evaluation to multimodal or dialogue-conditioned web interaction. AssistantBench Yoran et al. (2024) , WorkArena Drouin et al. (2024) , WorkArena++ Boisvert et al. (2024) , and TravelPlanner Xie et al. (2024a) further study realistic, time-consuming, or compositional information-seeking tasks, while AppWorld Trivedi et al. (2024) , OSWorld Xie et al. (2024b) , AndroidWorld Rawles et al. (2025) , and τ \tau -bench Yao et al. (2025) investigate stateful environments and tool-user interaction. Beyond task completion, recent studies have focused on evaluating whether agent responses are supported by external evidence. Mind2Web 2 Gou et al. (2025) introduces rubric-based Agent-as-a-Judge evaluation for citation-supported web responses. GAIA Mialon et al. (2024) , AssistantBench Yoran et al. (2024) , LiveResearchBench Wang et al. (2025) , and BrowseComp Wei et al. (2025) evaluate complex information seeking under external-knowledge and live-web settings. RAGChecker Ru et al. (2024) , long-form factuality evaluation Wei et al. (2024) , and RAGTruth Niu et al. (2024) further analyze retrieval support, claim correctness, and hallucination. These methods improve outcome evaluation, but mainly focus on final responses rather than indexed trajectory content related to answer groups judged incorrect.
paragraphs.zh: 网页智能体评估。 网页智能体评估已从孤立的浏览操作发展到现实的长时程交互和有证据支撑的任务完成。Mind2Web（Deng 等） （2023）为通用网页智能体引入了大规模真实网站任务，而 WebArena（Zhou 等） （2024）为自主交互提供了真实的多网站环境。AgentBench（Liu 等） （2024a）将大语言模型作为智能体在多种环境中进行评估。WebVoyager（He 等） （2024）、WebLINX（Lu 等） （2024）以及 VisualWebArena（Koh 等） （2024）将评估扩展到多模态或对话条件下的网页交互。 AssistantBench（Yoran 等） （2024）、WorkArena（Drouin 等） （2024）、WorkArena++（Boisvert 等） （2024）以及 TravelPlanner（Xie 等） （2024a）进一步研究了现实的、耗时的或组合式的信息获取任务，而 AppWorld（Trivedi 等） （2024）、OSWorld（Xie 等） （2024b）、AndroidWorld（Rawles 等） （2025）以及 τ \tau -bench（Yao 等） （2025）则研究了有状态环境与工具用户交互。 超越任务完成本身，近期的研究聚焦于评估智能体的回答是否有外部证据支撑。Mind2Web 2（Gou 等） （2025）为基于引用支撑的网页回答引入了基于评分标准的 Agent-as-a-Judge 评估方法。GAIA（Mialon 等） （2024）、AssistantBench（Yoran 等） （2024）、LiveResearchBench（Wang 等） （2025）以及 BrowseComp（Wei 等） （2025）在外部知识和实时网络环境下评估复杂的信息获取任务。RAGChecker（Ru 等） （2024）、长文本事实性评估（Wei 等） （2024）以及 RAGTruth（Niu 等） （2024）进一步分析了检索支撑、论断正确性与幻觉问题。 这些方法改进了结果评估，但主要聚焦于最终回答，而未涉及与被判定为错误的答案组相关的索引轨迹内容。

paragraphs.en: Process-Level Diagnosis. Process-level evaluation aims to identify failures beyond final outputs. Let’s Verify Step by Step Lightman et al. (2024) , Math-Shepherd Wang et al. (2024b) , and ProcessBench Zheng et al. (2025) show that intermediate-step verification can reveal reasoning failures beyond final-answer accuracy. AgentBoard Ma et al. (2024) introduces progress-level diagnostics for multi-turn agents, while error snowballing analysis Zhang et al. (2024) studies how early mistakes induce downstream failures. TELBench and DRIFT Wang et al. (2026) further extend process localization to DeepResearch trajectories by segmenting agent trajectories and identifying harmful error spans. These approaches demonstrate the value of process diagnosis. LongSearchEval connects source-constrained answer-group verification with retrospective localization of related observations, sources, and fields under a unified agent execution protocol. The final response and its judgments are inputs to this task; returned associations do not identify error onset.

paragraphs.en: LongSearchEval evaluates LLMs’ long-horizon web-search capabilities through a shared agent execution protocol and two complementary evaluation stages. For each model–task run, we jointly consider the source-grounded final response F F and the observable web-interaction trajectory τ \tau produced while solving the task. Agent execution under a unified protocol first provides comparable interaction records. Stage 1 then verifies source-supported answer groups in F F , and Stage 2 uses these judgments and F F to flag candidate locations and link their content to groups judged incorrect by Stage 1. Figure 2 illustrates the complete workflow.
paragraphs.zh: LongSearchEval 通过统一的智能体执行协议和两个互补的评估阶段来评估大语言模型的长程网络搜索能力。 对于每次模型-任务运行，我们同时考察有来源支撑的最终回答 F F 以及解决任务过程中产生的可观测的网络交互轨迹 τ \tau。 统一协议下的智能体执行首先提供了可比较的交互记录。 阶段 1 随后验证 F F 中有来源支持的答案组，阶段 2 利用这些判断和 F F 标记候选位置，并将其内容与阶段 1 判定为错误的答案组关联起来。 图 2 展示了完整的工作流程。

paragraphs.en: After collection, the resulting trajectory preserves the complete observable decision process from the task question to the final response, allowing subsequent evaluators to inspect where task-relevant defects are flagged and how these rounds relate to the retained final response.
paragraphs.zh: 收集完成后，所得轨迹完整保留了从任务问题到最终响应的可观测决策过程，使后续评估器能够检查任务相关缺陷在何处被标记，以及这些轮次与所保留的最终响应之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 evaluates how well the final response fulfills the task requirements by verifying its answer groups against the webpages cited in that response. For each group, the verifier checks whether the cited content supports all applicable requirements and then aggregates the group-level judgments into outcome scores. It uses only agent-provided URLs and performs no additional web search, enabling source-constrained evaluation without human-authored gold answers.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1 通过对照该回复中引用的网页来验证其答案组，评估最终回复在多大程度上满足了任务要求。 对于每个组，验证器会检查所引用的内容是否支持所有适用的要求，然后将组层面的判断汇总为结果分数。 它仅使用智能体提供的 URL，不执行额外的网络搜索，从而实现了无需人工撰写黄金答案的、受来源约束的评估。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2 traces answer groups judged incorrect by Stage 1 back to related webpage content in the recorded trajectory. For each such group, the localization task is to identify relevant observations, sources, or fields along the original round order, from the beginning of the trajectory onward. paragraphs.en: Agreement does not trigger arbitration. Joint errors retain the union of proposed links and use Judge A’s normalized error type when available, otherwise Judge B’s. paragraphs.en: Together, answer metrics and group verdicts characterize outcomes, while these three diagnostics summarize all flagged failure nodes, answer-linked failure nodes, and the earliest linked round. Auxiliary signals for search, content inspection, link navigation, and premature answering support complementary behavioral analyses. Both stages are model-identity blind; model IDs are attached only after judging.
paragraphs.zh: 两者结合，答案指标与组判定共同刻画结果，而这三项诊断则汇总所有被标记的失败节点、与答案关联的失败节点以及最早的关联轮次。 用于搜索、内容检查、链接导航和提前作答的辅助信号支持互补性的行为分析。 两个阶段均不感知模型身份；模型 ID 仅在评判之后才被附加。

paragraphs.en: We use LongSearchEval to compare LLMs’ long-horizon web-search performance through outcome scores, observable search behavior, and failure-node diagnostics, then assess outcome verification and diagnostic correspondence through human review.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 LongSearchEval 通过结果得分、可观测的搜索行为以及失败节点诊断来比较各 LLM 的长程网络搜索性能，随后通过人工评审来评估结果验证与诊断的对应性。

paragraphs.en: Tasks, models, and protocol. The evaluation comprises 16 models from eight families on 100 long-horizon web-search tasks: 46 from Mind2Web 2 Gou et al. (2025) , 20 from LiveResearchBench Wang et al. (2025) , 29 from AssistantBench Yoran et al. (2024) , and 5 manually curated tasks. All models use the same agent controller, prompt, five web-interaction tools, configured iteration limit, and execution policy. Each model–task pair contributes one retained run, giving 1,600 trajectories; recovery attempts do not create additional samples. The evaluated DeepSeek models are V3.2 and V4-Flash. Stage 1 uses DeepSeek-V4-Pro as its single verifier. Stage 2 uses DeepSeek-V4-Pro as Judge A and Qwen3.7-Max as Judge B and arbiter. This role assignment is fixed across all evaluated models and tasks; evaluated-model identities are omitted from judging inputs. The ten-category vocabulary is fixed from a disjoint 50-task, 500-trajectory development set.
paragraphs.zh: 任务、模型与协议。 该评估涵盖来自八个模型系列的 16 个模型，在 100 个长时程网络搜索任务上进行：其中 46 个来自 Mind2Web 2（Gou 等， 2025），20 个来自 LiveResearchBench（Wang 等， 2025），29 个来自 AssistantBench（Yoran 等， 2024），另有 5 个人工筛选的任务。 所有模型均使用相同的智能体控制器、提示词、五种网页交互工具、配置的迭代上限以及执行策略。 每个模型—任务对提供一次保留的运行，共得到 1,600 条轨迹；恢复尝试不会产生额外的样本。 被评估的 DeepSeek 模型为 V3.2 和 V4-Flash。 第一阶段使用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 作为其唯一验证器。 第二阶段使用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 作为裁判 A，Qwen3.7-Max 作为裁判 B 和仲裁者。 这一角色分配在所有被评估的模型和任务中保持固定；被评估模型的身份信息从评审输入中隐去。 十类词汇表由一个独立的包含 50 个任务、500 条轨迹的开发集固定下来。

The corpus contains 7,685 answer groups and 42,658 normalized rounds. Table 1 jointly reports outcome, behavior, evidence-use, and execution indicators. The minimum-count formula in Section 3.2 applies to min ; the stored exact normalization uses max ⁡ ( N , M ) \max(N,M) and dynamic_all uses M M as the AS/Upper denominator. AP uses max ⁡ ( M , 1 ) \max(M,1) , and confirmed empty outputs receive zero. These conventions retain the exported scores without changing the labels. Reported 95% intervals use 10,000 paired task-bootstrap resamples with fixed automatic outputs; they quantify task-level uncertainty rather than repeated agent execution.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows substantial variation under the shared interface. GPT-6.1-Sol has the highest point estimates for AS (68.80), AP (68.34%), and Upper (75.35), followed by GPT-6-Luna-Pro in AS (65.88) and AP (67.39%). GPT-5.4 has the lowest UGR (3.56%). The Sol–Luna AS difference is 2.92 points, with a paired 95% interval of [ − 5.67 , 11.99 ] [-5.67,11.99] , whereas the GLM-5–GLM-4.7-Flash difference is 14.67 points [ 8.41 , 20.82 ] [8.41,20.82] . paragraphs.en: Similar outcome scores can conceal different search profiles. DeepSeek-V3.2 and V4-Flash obtain AS values of 54.38 and 53.90, respectively, but average 13.75 versus 21.99 searches and 22.29k versus 37.60k read characters—about 37.5% fewer searches and 40.7% less text for V3.2. The paired AS difference is 0.48 points [ − 6.03 , 6.95 ] [-6.03,6.95] . Across models, search counts range from 9.49 to 21.99, and read text from 4.78k to 48.02k characters. Grok-4.20 returns the most final URLs (14.34 per run) without leading the outcome scores. Joint reporting therefore distinguishes verification success from interaction volume and evidence presentation.
paragraphs.zh: 相似的结果分数可能掩盖不同的搜索模式。 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 V4-Flash 分别获得 54.38 和 53.90 的 AS 值，但平均搜索次数为 13.75 对 21.99，读取字符数为 22.29k 对 37.60k——V3.2 的搜索次数约减少 37.5%，读取文本约减少 40.7%。 配对的 AS 差值为 0.48 分 [ − 6.03 , 6.95 ] [-6.03,6.95]。 在各模型之间，搜索次数范围为 9.49 到 21.99，读取文本范围为 4.78k 到 48.02k 字符。 Grok-4.20 返回最多的最终 URL（每次运行 14.34 个），但并未在结果分数上领先。 因此，联合报告能够将验证成功与交互量及证据呈现区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Among the 850 linked runs, the earliest returned association is by round 5 in 395 runs (46.5%) and by round 20 in 754 (88.7%); the median is round 6, with an interquartile range of 3–13. These locations identify related content for retrospective inspection, not when the agent first made an erroneous commitment. Constraint violation (2,124 nodes), insufficient evidence (1,782), and missing required field (1,222) account for 78.86% of typed nodes. The taxonomy summarizes the judges’ diagnostic categories over candidate content. Human validation below assesses correspondence between the returned locations and their target answer groups through a manual audit of all retained links in the sampled trajectories.

paragraphs.en: Audit design. The post-hoc audit covers 946 supplied answer groups across all tasks , with two randomly sampled model responses per task. Human labels serve as validation references, not inputs to scoring or localization. The primary reviewer (H1) checks requirements and the original cited URLs, assigns correct/incorrect/unverifiable labels, and derives response-level scores. Automatic verdicts, scores, reasons, and model metadata are withheld until annotation is locked. The review retains the supplied group boundaries, all 200 responses (including four confirmed empty-group responses), and both sides’ recorded quantity parameters. A second reviewer (H2) independently checks a fixed 40-response, 172-group subset. Reported intervals use 10,000 paired task-cluster bootstrap resamples, retaining each task’s two responses and all associated group-level records.
paragraphs.zh: 审计设计。 事后审计覆盖所有任务中的 946 个所提供的答案组，每个任务随机抽取两条模型回复。 人工标注仅作为验证参照，不作为评分或定位的输入。 主审（H1）核对需求及原始引用的 URL，标注正确/错误/无法验证标签，并得出回复层面的分数。 在标注锁定之前，自动判词、分数、理由及模型元信息均被屏蔽。 审核保留所提供的组边界、全部 200 条回复（包括四条确认为空组的回复）以及双方记录的数量参数。 第二位审核者（H2）独立核查固定的 40 条回复、172 个组的子集。 报告的区间采用 10,000 次成对任务聚类 bootstrap 重抽样，保留每个任务的两条回复及所有相关的组级记录。

sents.zh: 主审（H1）核对需求及原始引用的 URL，标注正确/错误/无法验证标签，并得出回复层面的分数。

sents.en: Automatic verdicts, scores, reasons, and model metadata are withheld until annotation is locked.
sents.zh: 在标注锁定之前，自动判词、分数、理由及模型元信息均被屏蔽。

sents.en: The review retains the supplied group boundaries, all 200 responses (including four confirmed empty-group responses), and both sides’ recorded quantity parameters.
sents.zh: 审核保留所提供的组边界、全部 200 条回复（包括四条确认为空组的回复）以及双方记录的数量参数。

sents.en: A second reviewer (H2) independently checks a fixed 40-response, 172-group subset.
sents.zh: 第二位审核者（H2）独立核查固定的 40 条回复、172 个组的子集。

sents.en: Reported intervals use 10,000 paired task-cluster bootstrap resamples, retaining each task’s two responses and all associated group-level records.
sents.zh: 报告的区间采用 10,000 次成对任务聚类 bootstrap 重抽样，保留每个任务的两条回复及所有相关的组级记录。

paragraphs.en: Outcome agreement. Table 3 reports Pearson r r , Spearman ρ \rho , and Kendall τ \tau on the same 200 response pairs. At group level, 894/946 judgments agree (94.50%; κ = 0.8989 \kappa=0.8989 ). AS and AP have mean absolute errors of 4.88 score points and 4.45 percentage points, with machine-minus-human biases of 0.84 and 0.46, respectively. The AS and AP Pearson 95% intervals are [ 0.8496 , 0.9519 ] [0.8496,0.9519] and [ 0.8595 , 0.9588 ] [0.8595,0.9588] . The two human reviewers agree on 160/172 subset group labels (93.02%; κ = 0.8574 \kappa=0.8574 ). Figure 5 complements these statistics by showing repeated exact matches across score levels and lower-frequency off-diagonal discrepancies. The agreement in group judgments and response-level scores supports the validity of source-constrained evaluation on the supplied answer groups.
paragraphs.zh: 结果一致性。 表3报告了在相同200组回答对上的Pearson r r、Spearman ρ \rho 和Kendall τ \tau。 在组级别上，894/946个判断一致（94.50%；κ = 0.8989 \kappa=0.8989）。 AS和AP的平均绝对误差分别为4.88分和4.45个百分点，机器减去人类的偏差分别为0.84和0.46。 AS和AP的Pearson 95%区间分别为 [ 0.8496 , 0.9519 ] [0.8496,0.9519] 和 [ 0.8595 , 0.9588 ] [0.8595,0.9588]。 两位人类评审在172组子集组标签中有160组一致（93.02%；κ = 0.8574 \kappa=0.8574）。 图5通过展示各分数水平上的重复精确匹配以及低频的非对角线差异，补充了这些统计结果。 组判断和回答级分数上的一致性支持了在所提供的答案组上进行源约束评估的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Within-task comparison. When both comparisons are non-tied, automatic and human orderings agree on 56/60 tasks for AS and 57/61 for AP. Including 28/27 shared ties gives 84/100 matching relations for each metric; each also has four reversed non-ties and 12 one-sided ties. These results assess within-task comparisons between the two sampled model responses.
paragraphs.zh: 任务内比较。 当两个比较均为非平局时，自动排序与人工排序在 AS 上有 56/60 个任务一致，在 AP 上有 57/61 个任务一致。 加上 28/27 个共同平局后，每个指标各有 84/100 个匹配的关系；每个指标还有四个相反的非平局和 12 个单侧平局。 这些结果评估的是两个采样模型响应之间的任务内比较。

paragraphs.en: Round-to-answer correspondence. The process sample covers all 2,642 normalized rounds of 100 runs from 50 randomly selected tasks. All 317 retained round–group links are reviewed, including every retained edge in the sample. A supported link shares a verified, locatable feature such as an entity, URL, provider, or price; topic similarity alone is insufficient. For split/merged groups, at least one mapped target must satisfy this rule. Review confirms 311/317 links, giving 98.11% feature-correspondence precision (95% CI: [ 96.15 , 99.40 ] [96.15,99.40] ). The audit supports high-precision localization of answer-related trajectory content under the defined feature-correspondence criterion.
paragraphs.zh: 回答与轮次的对应性。 过程样本覆盖了从 50 个随机选取任务、共 100 次运行中的全部 2,642 个规范化轮次。 所有 317 条保留的轮次—群组链接均经过审查，包括样本中的每条保留边。 受支持的链接共享一个经核实且可定位的特征，例如实体、URL、提供商或价格；仅话题相似是不够的。 对于拆分/合并的群组，至少一个映射目标必须满足该规则。 审查确认了 311/317 条链接，得到 98.11% 的特征对应精确率（95% 置信区间：[ 96.15 , 99.40 ] [96.15,99.40]）。 该审计支持在定义的特征对应标准下对与回答相关的轨迹内容进行高精度定位。

paragraphs.en: Audit criteria. A separate audit using an explicit erroneous-commitment criterion assigned no error labels to the reviewed rounds, whereas the candidate-content procedure produced 349 flags. These counts concern different annotation targets. The returned-link audit above evaluates the outcome-conditioned content-localization task defined in Section 3.3.

paragraphs.en: Internal consistency. Judges A and B agree on 12,417 of 14,818 round-level verdict pairs (83.80%). Among 4,612 rounds jointly labeled as error with comparable normalized types, their type judgments agree in 4,032 cases (87.42%). Together with human validation of answer scores and returned-link correspondence, these results provide empirical support for the effectiveness and reliability of LongSearchEval in source-constrained evaluation and retrospective trajectory-content localization.
paragraphs.zh: 内部一致性。 评判者 A 与评判者 B 在 14,818 个回合级判定对中有 12,417 个一致（83.80%）。 在 4,612 个被共同标注为错误且归一化类型可比的回合中，二者在 4,032 个案例中的类型判断一致（87.42%）。 结合对答案得分与返回链接对应关系的人工验证，这些结果为 LongSearchEval 在源约束评估和回溯性轨迹内容定位方面的有效性和可靠性提供了实证支持。

paragraphs.en: We presented LongSearchEval , a trajectory-aware agent evaluation framework for long-horizon web search that combines agent execution under a unified protocol, source-constrained outcome verification, and retrospective failure-node localization. The 16-model, 1,600-run corpus combines answer scores, search behavior, and inspectable round-group associations. Similar answer scores can accompany different search workloads. Conditioned on the final response and Stage 1 judgments, localization connects answer groups with inspectable trajectory content. Correct webpage observations can still be diagnostically useful when compared with a group judged incorrect; the full candidate inventory is reported separately from returned answer-linked evidence. Human validation demonstrates close alignment with reference answer judgments and high precision in returned content correspondences. Together with cross-judge agreement, these findings support the effectiveness and reliability of LongSearchEval for source-constrained outcome evaluation and retrospective trajectory inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 LongSearchEval，一个面向长程网络搜索的轨迹感知智能体评估框架，它结合了统一协议下的智能体执行、基于来源约束的结果验证以及回溯式失败节点定位。 该语料库包含 16 个模型、1,600 次运行，整合了答案得分、搜索行为以及可检查的轮次组关联。 相似的答案得分可能伴随不同的搜索工作负载。 在给定最终回复与第一阶段判定结果的条件下，定位将答案组与可检查的轨迹内容关联起来。 当与被判定为错误的答案组进行比较时，正确的网页观察结果仍然具有诊断价值；完整的候选网页清单与返回的答案关联证据分开报告。 人类验证表明，该框架与参考答案判定高度一致，并在返回的内容对应关系上具有高精确率。 结合评判者之间的一致性，这些发现支持了 LongSearchEval 在基于来源约束的结果评估与回溯式轨迹检查方面的有效性与可靠性。

paragraphs.en: This supplement details the LongSearchEval evaluation protocol and results. It follows the same 16-model, eight-family, 100-task comparison, with one retained run per model–task pair. It expands the collection protocol, source-constrained verification, retrospective content localization, and validation. Human review is a separate validation study, not an input to automatic evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 本补充材料详细介绍了 LongSearchEval 的评估协议与结果。 它沿用相同的对比设置：16 个模型、8 个模型家族、100 个任务，每个「模型–任务」对仅保留一次运行结果。 它扩展了收集协议、基于来源约束的验证、回溯性内容定位以及验证工作。 人工评审是一项独立的验证研究，并非自动评估的输入。

Each run has its own stored rubric R m , q = ( N , 𝒞 , ρ ) R_{m,q}=(N,\mathcal{C},\rho) , specifying the required answer count, hard constraints, and grouping rule, together with a count mode. Stage 1 extracts groups g i = ( a i , 𝒰 i ) g_{i}=(a_{i},\mathcal{U}_{i}) , comprising answer content and cited URLs, and labels each group correct, incorrect, or unverifiable.

paragraphs.en: Type shares use typed nodes only; human-review denominators are specified separately in Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: 类型份额仅使用类型化节点计算；人工审核的分母在附录 I 中单独说明。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation set targets long-horizon web search. Retained tasks require sustained information seeking over public webpages, explicit constraint tracking, and a final response whose answer items can be checked against cited webpage sources. The separate taxonomy-development set appears in Appendix G.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 该评测集针对长时程网络搜索。 保留的任务要求在公开网页上进行持续的信息检索、显式的约束跟踪，并且最终回复中的答案条目能够对照所引用的网页来源进行核验。 单独的分类体系开发集见附录 G.3。

sents.en: The evaluation set targets long-horizon web search.
sents.zh: 该评测集针对长时程网络搜索。

sents.en: Retained tasks require sustained information seeking over public webpages, explicit constraint tracking, and a final response whose answer items can be checked against cited webpage sources.
sents.zh: 保留的任务要求在公开网页上进行持续的信息检索、显式的约束跟踪，并且最终回复中的答案条目能够对照所引用的网页来源进行核验。

sents.en: The separate taxonomy-development set appears in Appendix G.3 .
sents.zh: 单独的分类体系开发集见附录 G.3。

paragraphs.en: A retained long-horizon web search task requires an agent to search, open, read, compare, and verify information from public webpages and then produce a response that can be checked from those webpages. Tasks may require multiple candidates, fields, sources, or constraint checks; they are not restricted to a single answer string or a single supporting page.
paragraphs.zh: 一个需要长期保持的网页搜索任务要求智能体在公开网页中搜索、打开、阅读、比较并验证信息，然后产出一个可以从这些网页中核验的回答。 任务可能需要多个候选、字段、来源或约束检查；它们并不局限于单一的答案字符串或单一的支持页面。

sents.en: A retained long-horizon web search task requires an agent to search, open, read, compare, and verify information from public webpages and then produce a response that can be checked from those webpages.
sents.zh: 一个需要长期保持的网页搜索任务要求智能体在公开网页中搜索、打开、阅读、比较并验证信息，然后产出一个可以从这些网页中核验的回答。

sents.en: Tasks may require multiple candidates, fields, sources, or constraint checks; they are not restricted to a single answer string or a single supporting page.
sents.zh: 任务可能需要多个候选、字段、来源或约束检查；它们并不局限于单一的答案字符串或单一的支持页面。

paragraphs.en: For every retained task, the final-answer instruction requires each answer item or answer group to include the corresponding webpage URL or URLs that verify the information in that group. When an original task does not specify how many items should be returned, the adapted task specifies an appropriate minimum count. This makes task-level coverage measurable while preserving group-level verification: a task can require at least N N valid groups, while each proposed group must independently satisfy all applicable hard constraints and source requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个保留的任务，最终答案指令要求每个答案项或答案组都包含用于验证该组信息的相应网页 URL 或多个 URL。 当原始任务未指定应返回多少项时，改写后的任务会指定一个适当的最小数量。 这使得任务层面的覆盖范围可度量，同时保留了组层面的验证：一个任务可以要求至少 N 个有效组，而每个提出的组必须独立满足所有适用的硬性约束和来源要求。

sents.en: For every retained task, the final-answer instruction requires each answer item or answer group to include the corresponding webpage URL or URLs that verify the information in that group.
sents.zh: 对于每个保留的任务，最终答案指令要求每个答案项或答案组都包含用于验证该组信息的相应网页 URL 或多个 URL。

sents.en: When an original task does not specify how many items should be returned, the adapted task specifies an appropriate minimum count.
sents.zh: 当原始任务未指定应返回多少项时，改写后的任务会指定一个适当的最小数量。

sents.en: This makes task-level coverage measurable while preserving group-level verification: a task can require at least N N valid groups, while each proposed group must independently satisfy all applicable hard constraints and source requirements.
sents.zh: 这使得任务层面的覆盖范围可度量，同时保留了组层面的验证：一个任务可以要求至少 N 个有效组，而每个提出的组必须独立满足所有适用的硬性约束和来源要求。

paragraphs.en: The adapted task text, including any added source or minimum-count requirement, defines the shared task specification for the evaluated models. The evaluation pipeline does not require a human-authored gold final answer or pre-labeled trajectory errors to generate the reported outcome and process diagnostics.
paragraphs.zh: 适配后的任务文本（包括任何新增的来源或最小数量要求）定义了被评估模型的共享任务规范。 该评估流程不需要人工编写的最终标准答案或预先标注的轨迹错误即可生成所报告的结果与过程诊断。

sents.en: The adapted task text, including any added source or minimum-count requirement, defines the shared task specification for the evaluated models.
sents.zh: 适配后的任务文本（包括任何新增的来源或最小数量要求）定义了被评估模型的共享任务规范。

sents.en: The evaluation pipeline does not require a human-authored gold final answer or pre-labeled trajectory errors to generate the reported outcome and process diagnostics.
sents.zh: 该评估流程不需要人工编写的最终标准答案或预先标注的轨迹错误即可生成所报告的结果与过程诊断。

paragraphs.en: The 100-task main evaluation set contains 46 tasks derived from Mind2Web 2, 20 from LiveResearchBench, 29 from AssistantBench, and 5 manually curated tasks. Model comparisons aggregate over the complete task set.
paragraphs.zh: 包含 100 个任务的主评测集由 46 个源自 Mind2Web 2 的任务、20 个源自 LiveResearchBench 的任务、29 个源自 AssistantBench 的任务以及 5 个人工精选的任务组成。 模型对比在完整任务集上进行汇总。

sents.en: The 100-task main evaluation set contains 46 tasks derived from Mind2Web 2, 20 from LiveResearchBench, 29 from AssistantBench, and 5 manually curated tasks.
sents.zh: 包含 100 个任务的主评测集由 46 个源自 Mind2Web 2 的任务、20 个源自 LiveResearchBench 的任务、29 个源自 AssistantBench 的任务以及 5 个人工精选的任务组成。

sents.en: Model comparisons aggregate over the complete task set.
sents.zh: 模型对比在完整任务集上进行汇总。

paragraphs.en: The five manually curated tasks are subjected to the same task-definition, source-grounding, and weak-tool-suitability requirements as the benchmark-derived tasks. They are included to supplement the retained benchmark subsets rather than to define a separate evaluation regime.
paragraphs.zh: 这五个经人工精选的任务与源自基准的任务遵循相同的任务定义、来源依据和弱工具适用性要求。 它们被纳入是为了补充保留的基准子集，而不是为了定义一个独立的评估体系。

sents.en: The five manually curated tasks are subjected to the same task-definition, source-grounding, and weak-tool-suitability requirements as the benchmark-derived tasks.
sents.zh: 这五个经人工精选的任务与源自基准的任务遵循相同的任务定义、来源依据和弱工具适用性要求。

sents.en: They are included to supplement the retained benchmark subsets rather than to define a separate evaluation regime.
sents.zh: 它们被纳入是为了补充保留的基准子集，而不是为了定义一个独立的评估体系。

paragraphs.en: Selection used five qualitative criteria: public-web feasibility, a need to compare multiple pages or candidates, explicit jointly applicable constraints, human-checkable evidence, and compatibility with the five shared tools. Tasks dependent on login, maps, decisive visual evidence, or unsupported interaction are excluded. Adaptation requires supporting URLs per answer group and adds an explicit minimum count where the original request leaves quantity open. Temporal, scope, source, formatting, and candidate-level conditions remain in the task shown to every model; they are not hidden scoring requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 选材采用了五项定性标准：公开网页可行性、需要比较多个页面或候选对象、明确且共同适用的约束条件、可由人工核验的证据，以及与五个共享工具的兼容性。 依赖登录、地图、决定性视觉证据或不受支持交互的任务被排除在外。 适配要求为每个答案组提供支撑 URL，并在原始请求未限定数量时加入明确的最少数量要求。 时间性、范围、来源、格式以及候选对象层面的条件保留在展示给每个模型的任务中；它们并非隐藏的评分要求。

sents.en: Selection used five qualitative criteria: public-web feasibility, a need to compare multiple pages or candidates, explicit jointly applicable constraints, human-checkable evidence, and compatibility with the five shared tools.
sents.zh: 选材采用了五项定性标准：公开网页可行性、需要比较多个页面或候选对象、明确且共同适用的约束条件、可由人工核验的证据，以及与五个共享工具的兼容性。

sents.en: Tasks dependent on login, maps, decisive visual evidence, or unsupported interaction are excluded.
sents.zh: 依赖登录、地图、决定性视觉证据或不受支持交互的任务被排除在外。

sents.en: Adaptation requires supporting URLs per answer group and adds an explicit minimum count where the original request leaves quantity open.
sents.zh: 适配要求为每个答案组提供支撑 URL，并在原始请求未限定数量时加入明确的最少数量要求。

sents.en: Temporal, scope, source, formatting, and candidate-level conditions remain in the task shown to every model; they are not hidden scoring requirements.
sents.zh: 时间性、范围、来源、格式以及候选对象层面的条件保留在展示给每个模型的任务中；它们并非隐藏的评分要求。

paragraphs.en: The core stored task object contains task_id, category, and question. The category field retains heterogeneous descriptive tags. Primary model results aggregate over all task IDs using the same task population.
paragraphs.zh: 核心存储的任务对象包含 task_id、category 和 question。 category 字段保留异构的描述性标签。 主要模型结果在所有任务 ID 上使用相同的任务总体进行汇总。

sents.en: The core stored task object contains task_id, category, and question.
sents.zh: 核心存储的任务对象包含 task_id、category 和 question。

sents.en: The category field retains heterogeneous descriptive tags.
sents.zh: category 字段保留异构的描述性标签。

sents.en: Primary model results aggregate over all task IDs using the same task population.
sents.zh: 主要模型结果在所有任务 ID 上使用相同的任务总体进行汇总。

paragraphs.en: Stored fields. task_id joins the task, trajectory, manifest, Stage 1, and Stage 2 artifacts; question records the adapted task text; and category is retained only as an unconsolidated descriptive tag.
paragraphs.zh: 存储字段。task_id 用于关联任务、轨迹、清单、第一阶段和第二阶段的产物；question 记录适配后的任务文本；category 仅作为一个未整合的描述性标签保留。

paragraphs.en: Derived diagnostics. question_word_count records prompt length, while rubric_variation describes field-level variation across run-specific rubrics in Appendix E . Neither quantity enters scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 衍生诊断指标。question_word_count 记录提示词长度，而 rubric_variation 描述附录 E 中各次运行专属评分细则在字段层面上的差异。 这两项数值均不参与评分。

sents.en: Derived diagnostics. question_word_count records prompt length, while rubric_variation describes field-level variation across run-specific rubrics in Appendix E .
sents.zh: 衍生诊断指标。question_word_count 记录提示词长度，而 rubric_variation 描述附录 E 中各次运行专属评分细则在字段层面上的差异。

sents.en: Neither quantity enters scoring.
sents.zh: 这两项数值均不参与评分。

paragraphs.en: Because Stage 1 reconstructs a rubric independently for every model–task run, exact free-text rubric hashes are not treated as task-level ground truth. All reported outcome scores use the rubric stored in the corresponding run report.
paragraphs.zh: 由于阶段 1 会为每次模型–任务运行独立重构评分标准，因此自由文本评分标准的精确哈希值不会被视作任务级真值。 所有报告的结果分数均使用对应运行报告中存储的评分标准。

sents.en: Because Stage 1 reconstructs a rubric independently for every model–task run, exact free-text rubric hashes are not treated as task-level ground truth.
sents.zh: 由于阶段 1 会为每次模型–任务运行独立重构评分标准，因此自由文本评分标准的精确哈希值不会被视作任务级真值。

paragraphs.en: The retained main comparison comprises 16 models from eight families, each evaluated on the same 100 tasks with the shared weak-tool controller. The run-selection manifest binds each retained trajectory to its evaluated model; trace02 identifies DeepSeek-V3.2 in this comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 保留的主比较包含来自八个系列的 16 个模型，每个模型都在相同的 100 个任务上使用共享的弱工具控制器进行评估。 运行选择清单将每个保留的轨迹绑定到其被评估的模型；trace02 在此比较中标识的是 DeepSeek-V3.2。

sents.en: The retained main comparison comprises 16 models from eight families, each evaluated on the same 100 tasks with the shared weak-tool controller.
sents.zh: 保留的主比较包含来自八个系列的 16 个模型，每个模型都在相同的 100 个任务上使用共享的弱工具控制器进行评估。

sents.en: The run-selection manifest binds each retained trajectory to its evaluated model; trace02 identifies DeepSeek-V3.2 in this comparison.
sents.zh: 运行选择清单将每个保留的轨迹绑定到其被评估的模型；trace02 在此比较中标识的是 DeepSeek-V3.2。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 uses DeepSeek-V4-Pro as a single verifier for rubric construction and source-constrained answer verification. Stage 2 uses DeepSeek-V4-Pro as Judge A and Qwen3.7-Max as Judge B; Qwen3.7-Max also supplies the arbiter. These assignments are fixed across evaluated models and tasks. Evaluated-model identity is excluded from evaluator inputs. Stage 1 uses the task, answer groups, and evidence from agent-provided URLs without replacement search. Each Stage 2 judge receives the task, run-specific rubric, final response, Stage 1 verdicts, and normalized round, without web access. Only the arbiter additionally receives the two judge outputs. Human review validates this automatic framework and is not an operational step in its evaluation pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段一使用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 作为单一验证者，用于评分标准构建和基于来源的答案验证。 阶段二使用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 作为评审 A，Qwen3.7-Max 作为评审 B；Qwen3.7-Max 同时提供仲裁者。 这些分配在被评估的模型和任务中保持固定。 被评估模型的身份不包含在评估者输入中。 阶段一使用任务、答案分组以及来自智能体提供的 URL 的证据，不进行补充搜索。 阶段二的每位评审接收任务、针对该次运行的评分标准、最终回复、阶段一的判定结果以及归一化的轮次信息，且无法访问网络。 只有仲裁者额外接收两位评审的输出。 人工审核用于验证这一自动框架，并非其评估流程中的操作性步骤。

sents.en: Stage 1 uses DeepSeek-V4-Pro as a single verifier for rubric construction and source-constrained answer verification.
sents.zh: 阶段一使用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 作为单一验证者，用于评分标准构建和基于来源的答案验证。

sents.en: Stage 2 uses DeepSeek-V4-Pro as Judge A and Qwen3.7-Max as Judge B; Qwen3.7-Max also supplies the arbiter.

sents.zh: 这些分配在被评估的模型和任务中保持固定。

sents.zh: 被评估模型的身份不包含在评估者输入中。

sents.en: Stage 1 uses the task, answer groups, and evidence from agent-provided URLs without replacement search.
sents.zh: 阶段一使用任务、答案分组以及来自智能体提供的 URL 的证据，不进行补充搜索。

sents.en: Each Stage 2 judge receives the task, run-specific rubric, final response, Stage 1 verdicts, and normalized round, without web access.
sents.zh: 阶段二的每位评审接收任务、针对该次运行的评分标准、最终回复、阶段一的判定结果以及归一化的轮次信息，且无法访问网络。

sents.en: Only the arbiter additionally receives the two judge outputs.
sents.zh: 只有仲裁者额外接收两位评审的输出。

paragraphs.en: This section expands the controlled collection protocol summarized in the main paper. All evaluated models use the same ReAct controller, system prompt, five-tool interface, iteration budget, and execution policy; only the underlying LLM varies during collection. Under these fixed conditions, the observable trajectory exposes model-side search planning, URL selection, page reading, keyword localization, link navigation, evidence checking, and final synthesis. Scoring uses a fixed evaluator configuration with independently reconstructed run-specific rubrics, as detailed in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 本节对正文概述的受控收集协议进行详细展开。 所有被评估的模型均使用相同的 ReAct 控制器、系统提示词、五工具接口、迭代预算和执行策略；在收集过程中仅底层 LLM 有所不同。 在这些固定条件下，可观测轨迹能够揭示模型侧的搜索规划、URL 选择、页面阅读、关键词定位、链接导航、证据核查以及最终综合。 评分采用固定的评估器配置，并使用独立重建的针对各次运行的评分细则，详见附录 E。

sents.en: This section expands the controlled collection protocol summarized in the main paper.
sents.zh: 本节对正文概述的受控收集协议进行详细展开。

sents.en: All evaluated models use the same ReAct controller, system prompt, five-tool interface, iteration budget, and execution policy; only the underlying LLM varies during collection.
sents.zh: 所有被评估的模型均使用相同的 ReAct 控制器、系统提示词、五工具接口、迭代预算和执行策略；在收集过程中仅底层 LLM 有所不同。

sents.en: Under these fixed conditions, the observable trajectory exposes model-side search planning, URL selection, page reading, keyword localization, link navigation, evidence checking, and final synthesis.
sents.zh: 在这些固定条件下，可观测轨迹能够揭示模型侧的搜索规划、URL 选择、页面阅读、关键词定位、链接导航、证据核查以及最终综合。

sents.en: Scoring uses a fixed evaluator configuration with independently reconstructed run-specific rubrics, as detailed in Appendix E .
sents.zh: 评分采用固定的评估器配置，并使用独立重建的针对各次运行的评分细则，详见附录 E。

paragraphs.en: Retained-run and recovery rules are specified in Appendix D.8 .
paragraphs.zh: 保留运行（retained-run）与恢复规则在附录 D.8 中规定。

paragraphs.en: The controlled interface keeps page selection, passage inspection, and strategy revision observable.
paragraphs.zh: 受控界面使页面选择、段落检查和策略修订保持可观察。

paragraphs.en: The agent is implemented as a text-style ReAct controller connected to an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint. Function-calling mode is disabled so that the controller emits an observable sequence of model messages, tool requests, tool results, and a terminal final-response marker. These records are captured by the collection framework and later converted into the normalized trajectory representation described in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体被实现为文本风格的 ReAct 控制器，并连接到兼容 OpenAI 的模型端点。 函数调用模式被禁用，以便控制器能够输出可观察的模型消息、工具请求、工具结果以及终止性的最终响应标记序列。 这些记录由采集框架捕获，并随后转换为附录 D 中描述的规范化轨迹表示。

sents.en: The agent is implemented as a text-style ReAct controller connected to an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint.
sents.zh: 该智能体被实现为文本风格的 ReAct 控制器，并连接到兼容 OpenAI 的模型端点。

sents.en: Function-calling mode is disabled so that the controller emits an observable sequence of model messages, tool requests, tool results, and a terminal final-response marker.
sents.zh: 函数调用模式被禁用，以便控制器能够输出可观察的模型消息、工具请求、工具结果以及终止性的最终响应标记序列。

sents.en: These records are captured by the collection framework and later converted into the normalized trajectory representation described in Appendix D .
sents.zh: 这些记录由采集框架捕获，并随后转换为附录 D 中描述的规范化轨迹表示。

paragraphs.en: A controller iteration may produce a tool request, an observation-dependent follow-up decision, or a terminal response. Malformed actions are first handled by the implementation’s mechanical parser recovery. If parsing still fails, the format error and expected action format are returned to the model, and the correction consumes another ReAct iteration rather than a separate malformed-action budget.
paragraphs.zh: 控制器的每次迭代可能产生一个工具请求、一个依赖于观测结果的后续决策，或一个终止响应。 格式错误的动作首先由实现的机械解析器恢复机制处理。 如果解析仍然失败，格式错误和预期的动作格式会被返回给模型，而纠正过程会消耗另一次 ReAct 迭代，而不是单独的格式错误动作预算。

sents.en: A controller iteration may produce a tool request, an observation-dependent follow-up decision, or a terminal response.
sents.zh: 控制器的每次迭代可能产生一个工具请求、一个依赖于观测结果的后续决策，或一个终止响应。

sents.en: Malformed actions are first handled by the implementation’s mechanical parser recovery.
sents.zh: 格式错误的动作首先由实现的机械解析器恢复机制处理。

sents.en: If parsing still fails, the format error and expected action format are returned to the model, and the correction consumes another ReAct iteration rather than a separate malformed-action budget.
sents.zh: 如果解析仍然失败，格式错误和预期的动作格式会被返回给模型，而纠正过程会消耗另一次 ReAct 迭代，而不是单独的格式错误动作预算。

paragraphs.en: The agent registers exactly five web tools. Their roles are intentionally separated so that discovering a URL, opening a page, reading its body text, locating a literal term, and following links remain distinct model decisions. The model-visible contracts are:
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体恰好注册了五个网页工具。 它们的职责被有意分开，使得发现 URL、打开页面、读取正文文本、定位字面词以及跟踪链接始终是各自独立的模型决策。 模型可见的契约如下：

sents.en: The agent registers exactly five web tools.
sents.zh: 该智能体恰好注册了五个网页工具。

sents.en: Their roles are intentionally separated so that discovering a URL, opening a page, reading its body text, locating a literal term, and following links remain distinct model decisions.
sents.zh: 它们的职责被有意分开，使得发现 URL、打开页面、读取正文文本、定位字面词以及跟踪链接始终是各自独立的模型决策。

sents.en: The model-visible contracts are:
sents.zh: 模型可见的契约如下：

paragraphs.en: web_search. Input is a query and requested result count, capped at 10. The model receives only the query plus ranked titles, URLs, and domains. Snippets, page content, answer boxes, knowledge-graph fields, summaries, semantic chunks, relevance scores, and direct answers are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: web_search。 输入是一个查询和请求的结果数量，上限为 10。 智能体只接收查询以及经过排序的标题、URL 和域名。 摘要片段、页面内容、答案框、知识图谱字段、内容总结、语义分块、相关性评分和直接答案均被排除在外。

sents.en: web_search.
sents.zh: web_search。

sents.en: Input is a query and requested result count, capped at 10.
sents.zh: 输入是一个查询和请求的结果数量，上限为 10。

sents.en: The model receives only the query plus ranked titles, URLs, and domains.
sents.zh: 智能体只接收查询以及经过排序的标题、URL 和域名。

sents.en: Snippets, page content, answer boxes, knowledge-graph fields, summaries, semantic chunks, relevance scores, and direct answers are excluded.
sents.zh: 摘要片段、页面内容、答案框、知识图谱字段、内容总结、语义分块、相关性评分和直接答案均被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: open_url. Input is a candidate URL. The tool returns a page identifier and metadata: requested and resolved URLs, status, title, cleaned-text length, extracted-link count, and cache status. It does not return body text, a relevant passage, a main-content summary, a query-aware fragment, or an LLM-generated description.
paragraphs.zh: open_url。 输入是一个候选 URL。 该工具返回页面标识符和元数据：请求的 URL 与解析后的 URL、状态、标题、清洗后文本的长度、提取到的链接数量以及缓存状态。 它不返回正文文本、相关段落、主要内容摘要、基于查询的片段或由大语言模型生成的描述。

sents.en: open_url.
sents.zh: open_url。

sents.en: Input is a candidate URL.
sents.zh: 输入是一个候选 URL。

sents.en: The tool returns a page identifier and metadata: requested and resolved URLs, status, title, cleaned-text length, extracted-link count, and cache status.
sents.zh: 该工具返回页面标识符和元数据：请求的 URL 与解析后的 URL、状态、标题、清洗后文本的长度、提取到的链接数量以及缓存状态。

sents.en: It does not return body text, a relevant passage, a main-content summary, a query-aware fragment, or an LLM-generated description.
sents.zh: 它不返回正文文本、相关段落、主要内容摘要、基于查询的片段或由大语言模型生成的描述。

paragraphs.en: read_page. Inputs are a page identifier, start offset, and requested character count (default 3,000; hard cap 5,000). The return is an exact character slice from mechanically cleaned cached text. No rewriting, compression, semantic filtering, reranking, or summarization is applied.
paragraphs.zh: read_page。 输入包括页面标识符、起始偏移量以及请求的字符数（默认 3,000；硬性上限 5,000）。 返回值是从经过机械清洗的缓存文本中截取的精确字符切片。 不做任何改写、压缩、语义过滤、重排序或摘要处理。

sents.en: read_page.
sents.zh: read_page。

sents.en: Inputs are a page identifier, start offset, and requested character count (default 3,000; hard cap 5,000).
sents.zh: 输入包括页面标识符、起始偏移量以及请求的字符数（默认 3,000；硬性上限 5,000）。

sents.en: The return is an exact character slice from mechanically cleaned cached text.
sents.zh: 返回值是从经过机械清洗的缓存文本中截取的精确字符切片。

sents.en: No rewriting, compression, semantic filtering, reranking, or summarization is applied.
sents.zh: 不做任何改写、压缩、语义过滤、重排序或摘要处理。

paragraphs.en: find_on_page. Inputs are a page identifier, literal keyword, maximum matches, and context width. The model receives case-insensitive exact-substring matches with local cached-text context, without semantic search, BM25, embeddings, query expansion, fuzzy retrieval, or LLM extraction.
paragraphs.zh: find_on_page。 输入为页面标识符、字面关键词、最大匹配数和上下文宽度。 模型接收不区分大小写的精确子串匹配及本地缓存文本上下文，不涉及语义搜索、BM25、嵌入、查询扩展、模糊检索或 LLM 提取。

sents.en: find_on_page.
sents.zh: find_on_page。

sents.en: Inputs are a page identifier, literal keyword, maximum matches, and context width.
sents.zh: 输入为页面标识符、字面关键词、最大匹配数和上下文宽度。

sents.en: The model receives case-insensitive exact-substring matches with local cached-text context, without semantic search, BM25, embeddings, query expansion, fuzzy retrieval, or LLM extraction.
sents.zh: 模型接收不区分大小写的精确子串匹配及本地缓存文本上下文，不涉及语义搜索、BM25、嵌入、查询扩展、模糊检索或 LLM 提取。

paragraphs.en: extract_links. Inputs are a page identifier and maximum link count. The tool mechanically returns anchor text and absolute URLs, without relevance ranking, recommendations, target-page summaries, or preselection of “useful” links.
paragraphs.zh: extract_links。 输入为一个页面标识符和最大链接数量。 该工具机械地返回锚文本和绝对 URL，不进行相关性排序、推荐、目标页面摘要或「有用」链接的预筛选。

sents.en: extract_links.
sents.zh: extract_links。

sents.en: Inputs are a page identifier and maximum link count.
sents.zh: 输入为一个页面标识符和最大链接数量。

sents.en: The tool mechanically returns anchor text and absolute URLs, without relevance ranking, recommendations, target-page summaries, or preselection of “useful” links.
sents.zh: 该工具机械地返回锚文本和绝对 URL，不进行相关性排序、推荐、目标页面摘要或「有用」链接的预筛选。

paragraphs.en: Figure A1 follows Qwen3.7-Plus on ds_003_trace_03 : R11 discovers the BMA House URL, R12 opens it, and R13–R14 read and search the same cached page. Each step is a separate normalized round. R13 exposes 3,000 of the 10,376 cached characters, and R14 returns four literal matches for delegate . The displayed “Thought” is model-emitted controller text. The terminal response is stored separately from these normalized rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 图 A1 展示了 Qwen3.7-Plus 在 ds_003_trace_03 上的运行：R11 发现 BMA House 的 URL，R12 打开它，R13–R14 读取并搜索同一个缓存页面。 每一步都是一个独立的规范化轮次。 R13 暴露了 10,376 个缓存字符中的 3,000 个，R14 为 delegate 返回了四个字面匹配。 显示的「Thought」是模型生成的控制器文本。 最终回复与这些规范化轮次分开存储。

sents.en: Figure A1 follows Qwen3.7-Plus on ds_003_trace_03 : R11 discovers the BMA House URL, R12 opens it, and R13–R14 read and search the same cached page.
sents.zh: 图 A1 展示了 Qwen3.7-Plus 在 ds_003_trace_03 上的运行：R11 发现 BMA House 的 URL，R12 打开它，R13–R14 读取并搜索同一个缓存页面。

sents.en: Each step is a separate normalized round.
sents.zh: 每一步都是一个独立的规范化轮次。

sents.en: R13 exposes 3,000 of the 10,376 cached characters, and R14 returns four literal matches for delegate .
sents.zh: R13 暴露了 10,376 个缓存字符中的 3,000 个，R14 为 delegate 返回了四个字面匹配。

sents.en: The displayed “Thought” is model-emitted controller text.
sents.zh: 显示的「Thought」是模型生成的控制器文本。

sents.en: The terminal response is stored separately from these normalized rounds.
sents.zh: 最终回复与这些规范化轮次分开存储。

paragraphs.en: Parser corrections consume ordinary iterations, requests above a tool cap are truncated, and a failed web request is returned as an observable tool error. The LLM timeout applies per request attempt, not to the complete trajectory; no fixed end-to-end wall-clock limit is imposed.
paragraphs.zh: 解析器修正会消耗普通迭代次数，超过工具调用上限的请求会被截断，而失败的网页请求会作为可观察的工具错误返回。 LLM 超时适用于每次请求尝试，而不是整个轨迹；不设固定的端到端墙上时钟时间限制。

sents.en: Parser corrections consume ordinary iterations, requests above a tool cap are truncated, and a failed web request is returned as an observable tool error.
sents.zh: 解析器修正会消耗普通迭代次数，超过工具调用上限的请求会被截断，而失败的网页请求会作为可观察的工具错误返回。

sents.en: The LLM timeout applies per request attempt, not to the complete trajectory; no fixed end-to-end wall-clock limit is imposed.
sents.zh: LLM 超时适用于每次请求尝试，而不是整个轨迹；不设固定的端到端墙上时钟时间限制。

paragraphs.en: The 660-second watchdog measures absence of subprocess output, not absence of a new webpage or search result. It is therefore distinct from the soft and hard search-stagnation counters. The latter monitor search progress inside the agent, whereas the watchdog monitors whether the batch subprocess is still producing observable output.
paragraphs.zh: 这个660秒的看门狗检测的是子进程没有输出，而不是没有新网页或新搜索结果。 因此它与软、硬搜索停滞计数器是不同的。 后者监控智能体内部的搜索进度，而看门狗监控的是批量子进程是否仍在产生可观察的输出。

sents.en: The 660-second watchdog measures absence of subprocess output, not absence of a new webpage or search result.
sents.zh: 这个660秒的看门狗检测的是子进程没有输出，而不是没有新网页或新搜索结果。

sents.en: It is therefore distinct from the soft and hard search-stagnation counters.
sents.zh: 因此它与软、硬搜索停滞计数器是不同的。

sents.en: The latter monitor search progress inside the agent, whereas the watchdog monitors whether the batch subprocess is still producing observable output.
sents.zh: 后者监控智能体内部的搜索进度，而看门狗监控的是批量子进程是否仍在产生可观察的输出。

paragraphs.en: For each retained model–task trajectory, the collection project stores raw and human-inspectable interaction records, run metadata, behavioral metrics, and checkpoint state. Run identifiers join these records to tasks and model metadata.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每条保留的模型–任务轨迹，收集项目会存储原始且可供人工检查的交互记录、运行元数据、行为指标以及检查点状态。 运行标识符将这些记录与任务及模型元数据关联起来。

sents.en: For each retained model–task trajectory, the collection project stores raw and human-inspectable interaction records, run metadata, behavioral metrics, and checkpoint state.
sents.zh: 对于每条保留的模型–任务轨迹，收集项目会存储原始且可供人工检查的交互记录、运行元数据、行为指标以及检查点状态。

sents.en: Run identifiers join these records to tasks and model metadata.
sents.zh: 运行标识符将这些记录与任务及模型元数据关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Interaction records. The raw record preserves ordered model messages, tool calls, observations, and terminal output. The human-inspectable trajectory adds normalized model-decision blocks and trajectory-round boundaries for downstream auditing.
paragraphs.zh: 交互记录。 原始记录按顺序保存模型消息、工具调用、观测结果和终端输出。 供人工检查的轨迹会增加规范化的模型决策块和轨迹轮次边界，以便下游审计使用。

sents.en: Interaction records.
sents.zh: 交互记录。

sents.en: The raw record preserves ordered model messages, tool calls, observations, and terminal output.
sents.zh: 原始记录按顺序保存模型消息、工具调用、观测结果和终端输出。

sents.en: The human-inspectable trajectory adds normalized model-decision blocks and trajectory-round boundaries for downstream auditing.
sents.zh: 供人工检查的轨迹会增加规范化的模型决策块和轨迹轮次边界，以便下游审计使用。

paragraphs.en: Join and recovery metadata. Manifests store run, task, model, trajectory, configuration, and artifact identifiers; checkpoint state supports resumption without creating an additional experimental sample.
paragraphs.zh: 加入与恢复元数据。 清单存储运行、任务、模型、轨迹、配置和工件标识符；检查点状态支持恢复，而无需创建额外的实验样本。

sents.en: Join and recovery metadata.
sents.zh: 加入与恢复元数据。

paragraphs.en: Behavioral and finalization diagnostics. Tool-use fields summarize calls, domains, URLs, and text read. Separate finalization fields record answer provenance, termination, evidence use, validator status, premature answering, and budget exhaustion; they do not form one mutually exclusive state.
paragraphs.zh: 行为与终结诊断信息。 工具使用字段汇总调用的次数、域名、URL 以及读取的文本。 独立的终结字段分别记录答案来源、终止情况、证据使用、验证器状态、过早作答以及预算耗尽；它们并不构成一个互斥的整体状态。

sents.en: Behavioral and finalization diagnostics.
sents.zh: 行为与终结诊断信息。

sents.en: Tool-use fields summarize calls, domains, URLs, and text read.
sents.zh: 工具使用字段汇总调用的次数、域名、URL 以及读取的文本。

sents.en: Separate finalization fields record answer provenance, termination, evidence use, validator status, premature answering, and budget exhaustion; they do not form one mutually exclusive state.
sents.zh: 独立的终结字段分别记录答案来源、终止情况、证据使用、验证器状态、过早作答以及预算耗尽；它们并不构成一个互斥的整体状态。

paragraphs.en: Existing code identifiers may retain the legacy term trace; the paper-facing description uses trajectory .
paragraphs.zh: 现有的代码标识符可能保留旧术语 trace；面向论文的描述使用 trajectory。

paragraphs.en: The large internal webpage caches are not part of the paper-facing package. The archived analysis records contain the URLs and observable webpage text presented within the trajectory records, together with final responses, manifests, metrics, and evaluation reports. The implications for exact re-aggregation and live-web re-verification are discussed in Appendix K .
paragraphs.zh: 大型内部网页缓存不包含在面向论文的软件包中。 归档的分析记录包含轨迹记录中呈现的 URL 和可观察的网页文本，以及最终响应、清单、指标和评估报告。 关于精确重新聚合和实时网络重新验证的影响在附录 K 中进行了讨论。

sents.en: The large internal webpage caches are not part of the paper-facing package.
sents.zh: 大型内部网页缓存不包含在面向论文的软件包中。

sents.en: The archived analysis records contain the URLs and observable webpage text presented within the trajectory records, together with final responses, manifests, metrics, and evaluation reports.
sents.zh: 归档的分析记录包含轨迹记录中呈现的 URL 和可观察的网页文本，以及最终响应、清单、指标和评估报告。

sents.zh: 关于精确重新聚合和实时网络重新验证的影响在附录 K 中进行了讨论。

paragraphs.en: The collection framework records low-level observable events, whereas LongSearchEval operates on normalized trajectory rounds and a separate terminal final response. This section specifies the transformation between these representations and distinguishes trajectory construction from terminal validation, collection-time final synthesis, and infrastructure recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 采集框架记录低层可观察事件，而 LongSearchEval 则在规范化后的轨迹轮次和单独的终端最终回复上进行操作。 本节规定这些表示之间的转换，并将轨迹构建与终端验证、采集时的最终综合以及基础设施恢复区分开来。

sents.en: The collection framework records low-level observable events, whereas LongSearchEval operates on normalized trajectory rounds and a separate terminal final response.
sents.zh: 采集框架记录低层可观察事件，而 LongSearchEval 则在规范化后的轨迹轮次和单独的终端最终回复上进行操作。

sents.en: This section specifies the transformation between these representations and distinguishes trajectory construction from terminal validation, collection-time final synthesis, and infrastructure recovery.
sents.zh: 本节规定这些表示之间的转换，并将轨迹构建与终端验证、采集时的最终综合以及基础设施恢复区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The raw record preserves observable controller events in chronological order: the task question, model-produced ReAct messages, tool requests and results, and a terminal final-answer marker. The formatted record uses event classes such as Question, ReasoningRound, ToolCall, ToolCallResult, and FinalAnswer. Trajectory construction uses only this recorded interaction; hidden model states and external web evidence are outside the extractor’s inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 原始记录按时间顺序保留了可观测的控制器事件：任务问题、模型生成的 ReAct 消息、工具请求与结果，以及终止性的最终答案标记。 格式化记录使用诸如 Question、ReasoningRound、ToolCall、ToolCallResult 和 FinalAnswer 等事件类别。 轨迹构建仅使用这条被记录的交互；隐藏的模型状态与外部网络证据不在抽取器的输入范围之内。

sents.en: The raw record preserves observable controller events in chronological order: the task question, model-produced ReAct messages, tool requests and results, and a terminal final-answer marker.
sents.zh: 原始记录按时间顺序保留了可观测的控制器事件：任务问题、模型生成的 ReAct 消息、工具请求与结果，以及终止性的最终答案标记。

sents.en: The formatted record uses event classes such as Question, ReasoningRound, ToolCall, ToolCallResult, and FinalAnswer.
sents.zh: 格式化记录使用诸如 Question、ReasoningRound、ToolCall、ToolCallResult 和 FinalAnswer 等事件类别。

sents.en: Trajectory construction uses only this recorded interaction; hidden model states and external web evidence are outside the extractor’s inputs.
sents.zh: 轨迹构建仅使用这条被记录的交互；隐藏的模型状态与外部网络证据不在抽取器的输入范围之内。

paragraphs.en: The production extractor preserves event order and applies deterministic boundaries to the observable ReAct sequence. A new model-decision turn opens a round; tool actions and results follow the implemented tool-stage order. A round may begin at open_url or a later stage when earlier stages are absent. A transition back to an earlier stage can open another round: for example, find_on_page followed by open_url creates a boundary under the production ordering.
paragraphs.zh: 生产级提取器保持事件顺序，并对可观察的 ReAct 序列应用确定性边界。 一个新的模型决策轮次开启一轮；工具动作和结果遵循已实现的工具阶段顺序。 当较早的阶段缺失时，一轮可以从 open_url 或更晚的阶段开始。 回退到较早阶段的转换可以开启另一轮：例如，find_on_page 之后跟 open_url 会在生产排序下创建一个边界。

sents.en: The production extractor preserves event order and applies deterministic boundaries to the observable ReAct sequence.
sents.zh: 生产级提取器保持事件顺序，并对可观察的 ReAct 序列应用确定性边界。

sents.en: A new model-decision turn opens a round; tool actions and results follow the implemented tool-stage order.
sents.zh: 一个新的模型决策轮次开启一轮；工具动作和结果遵循已实现的工具阶段顺序。

sents.en: A round may begin at open_url or a later stage when earlier stages are absent.
sents.zh: 当较早的阶段缺失时，一轮可以从 open_url 或更晚的阶段开始。

sents.en: A transition back to an earlier stage can open another round: for example, find_on_page followed by open_url creates a boundary under the production ordering.
sents.zh: 回退到较早阶段的转换可以开启另一轮：例如，find_on_page 之后跟 open_url 会在生产排序下创建一个边界。

paragraphs.en: Rounds therefore differ from raw events and individual tool calls. Their boundaries follow recorded decisions and tool-stage transitions without post-hoc human segmentation by topic, candidate set, or semantic similarity. The terminal response is extracted separately and receives no round index. The production extractor’s event-type branches specify the exact boundary rules.

paragraphs.en: The terminal-output parser distinguishes a canonical agent final response from intermediate tool syntax or malformed terminal content. Final-answer validity checks reject, among other cases:

sents.en: The terminal-output parser distinguishes a canonical agent final response from intermediate tool syntax or malformed terminal content.
sents.zh: 终端输出解析器将规范化的智能体最终响应与中间工具语法或格式错误的终端内容区分开来。

sents.en: Final-answer validity checks reject, among other cases:
sents.zh: 最终答案有效性检查会拒绝以下情形等多种情况：

paragraphs.en: raw tool-call text, tool JSON, or XML-style tool-call syntax;
paragraphs.zh: 原始工具调用文本、工具 JSON 或 XML 风格的工具调用语法；

paragraphs.en: page metadata presented as if it were the answer;
paragraphs.zh: 页面元数据被当作答案来呈现；

paragraphs.en: malformed terminal content that cannot be interpreted as a final response;
paragraphs.zh: 无法被解释为最终回复的格式错误的终端内容；

paragraphs.en: an answer produced before any executed page-text reading or literal-search evidence operation.
paragraphs.zh: 在任何已执行的页面文本读取或字面搜索证据操作之前生成的回答。

paragraphs.en: The last condition implements the evidence-before-answer requirement: search titles and opened-page metadata alone do not count as page-text evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 最后一个条件实现了「先证据后回答」的要求：仅凭搜索标题和已打开页面的元数据，并不构成页面文本证据。

paragraphs.en: If terminal output is invalid but the trajectory already contains usable evidence, the collection framework may request a no-tool final-only synthesis. The model receives the already collected context but cannot invoke additional web tools. The current configuration permits up to two final-synthesis attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 如果终端输出无效但轨迹中已包含可用的证据，采集框架可能会请求一次“仅最终综合、不使用工具”的操作。 模型会接收已收集的上下文，但无法调用其他网络工具。 当前配置允许最多进行两次最终综合尝试。

paragraphs.en: A synthesized final answer is recorded through explicit final-answer provenance fields rather than inferred from answer text or stored as a second trajectory. The collection record sets final_answer_source to final_recovery; the manifest and finalization record persist the same source value. Downstream audit code derives the final_only_synthesis flag strictly from this field.
paragraphs.zh: 合成的最终答案通过显式的最终答案溯源字段进行记录，而不是从答案文本推断或作为第二条轨迹存储。 收集记录将 final_answer_source 设置为 final_recovery；清单和完成记录持久化相同的来源值。 下游审计代码严格依据该字段推导 final_only_synthesis 标志。

paragraphs.en: If usable evidence is unavailable, the framework preserves an invalid fallback rather than fabricating a source-grounded response. Final-only synthesis records a distinct terminal-response construction path; the resulting answer undergoes the same collection checks and subsequent evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 若可用证据不可得，框架会保留一个无效的回退结果，而不是编造一个有来源依据的回复。 仅在最终阶段进行的综合会记录一条独立的终端回复构建路径；由此得到的答案同样会经过相同的收集检查和后续评估。

paragraphs.en: The recovery layers may overlap, but none creates an additional experimental replicate:
paragraphs.zh: 各恢复层之间可能存在重叠，但它们都不会创建额外的实验重复：

paragraphs.en: Request layer. Web-tool HTTP calls are not automatically retried; a backend exception becomes an observable tool error. Model requests use framework retry setting 5, while malformed provider response objects permit up to three shape-recovery attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 请求层。 网络工具的 HTTP 调用不会自动重试；后端异常会成为可观察到的工具错误。 模型请求使用框架重试设置 5，而格式错误的提供方响应对象允许最多三次结构恢复尝试。

sents.en: Request layer.
sents.zh: 请求层。

sents.en: Web-tool HTTP calls are not automatically retried; a backend exception becomes an observable tool error.
sents.zh: 网络工具的 HTTP 调用不会自动重试；后端异常会成为可观察到的工具错误。

sents.en: Model requests use framework retry setting 5, while malformed provider response objects permit up to three shape-recovery attempts.
sents.zh: 模型请求使用框架重试设置 5，而格式错误的提供方响应对象允许最多三次结构恢复尝试。

paragraphs.en: Controller layer. Mechanical parser recovery is attempted for malformed ReAct actions; unresolved format errors consume ordinary ReAct iterations rather than a separate retry budget.
paragraphs.zh: 控制器层。 对于格式错误的 ReAct 动作，会尝试进行机械解析恢复；未能解决的格式错误将消耗普通的 ReAct 迭代次数，而不是单独的重试预算。

sents.en: Controller layer.
sents.zh: 控制器层。

paragraphs.en: Process layer. A failed batch subprocess permits up to two attempts, and a saved runtime checkpoint permits up to three auto-resume attempts. Resume markers remain observable in the retained artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 流程层。 失败的批处理子流程最多允许两次尝试，保存的运行时检查点最多允许三次自动恢复尝试。 恢复标记在保留的工件中仍然可观察。

sents.en: Resume markers remain observable in the retained artifact.
sents.zh: 恢复标记在保留的工件中仍然可观察。

paragraphs.en: Terminal layer. Collection-time no-tool final-only synthesis permits up to two attempts using already collected evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 终端层。 采集阶段的无工具、仅最终答案的综合允许使用已收集的证据进行最多两次尝试。

paragraphs.en: Provider connection, timeout, rate-limit, and internal-server exceptions are handled by the model-request layer. Web-tool exceptions are instead returned as observable tool errors. If a runtime exception persists, the framework saves a checkpoint before applying the configured resume policy.

paragraphs.en: Availability and provenance. has_final_answer records whether a terminal object is present. final_answer_source distinguishes agent, final_recovery, and fallback, while final_answer_reason records the selected terminal path.
paragraphs.zh: 可用性与来源。has_final_answer 记录是否存在终止对象。final_answer_source 区分智能体（agent）、最终恢复（final_recovery）和回退（fallback），而 final_answer_reason 记录所选的终止路径。

paragraphs.en: Budget, evidence, and validation. max_iterations_reached may coexist with a saved response; evidence_requirement_met records whether page text was obtained before finalization; and the validity flags plus final_answer_invalid_reason record the terminal validator outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 预算、证据与校验。max_iterations_reached 可能与已保存的响应共存；evidence_requirement_met 记录在最终确定前是否获取了页面文本；而有效性标志位加上 final_answer_invalid_reason 记录终止校验器的结果。

paragraphs.en: The rubric is reconstructed separately for every retained run rather than generated once and shared across all 16 models. This reflects the implemented evaluation pipeline; each run is scored using the rubric stored in its own report. The evaluated model identity is excluded from rubric generation, and no canonical rubric is substituted post hoc when computing the reported scores. The fixed evaluator configuration and saved run-specific rubrics jointly define the scoring protocol. Field-level consistency across the 16 reconstructions per task is summarized at the end of this section.

paragraphs.en: Group extraction is automatic and is not manually corrected before scoring. Multiple URLs may be attached to one group, including cases in which different URLs support different required fields. Missing citations yield an empty URL set rather than external source discovery by the evaluator. Responses that do not follow the requested output format are still parsed when the required answer units can be recovered from the response; otherwise, missing or malformed content is reflected in the extracted groups and subsequent verdicts.
paragraphs.zh: 组提取是自动进行的，在评分前不会进行人工修正。 多个 URL 可以附加到同一个组，包括不同 URL 支持不同必填字段的情况。 缺少引用会产生空的 URL 集合，而不是由评估器进行外部来源查找。 对于未遵循所要求输出格式的回复，只要能从回复中恢复出所需的答案单元，仍会被解析；否则，缺失或格式错误的内容会体现在提取的组及后续判定结果中。

paragraphs.en: When a group cites multiple URLs, the verifier considers their available texts jointly. Different sources may support different fields or constraints of the same group, and no single URL is required to establish every field when the combined cited evidence is sufficient. Conversely, the presence of one relevant URL does not make the group correct when another required field remains unsupported.
paragraphs.zh: 当一个组引用了多个 URL 时，校验器会综合考量这些 URL 的可用文本。 不同的来源可以支持同一个组的不同字段或约束，当组合引用的证据已足够时，不需要由单个 URL 来确立每一个字段。 反之，当另一个必需字段仍然缺乏支持时，某一个相关 URL 的存在并不能使该组正确。

paragraphs.en: The verifier does not apply a fixed preference for official, primary, or secondary sources unless the task itself imposes an explicit source-quality constraint. When cited sources disagree, the Stage 1 judge resolves the group using the complete cited evidence and emits one of the existing three verdicts; the implementation does not introduce a separate unresolved-conflict category. With mixed usable and inaccessible sources, the verdict follows the usable cited evidence and applicable answer-visible requirements. The formal rule below separates these checks from access uncertainty.
